Can be bought from the [[Bishop]] as a Tier I [[Items|Item]]. They can be used either as food - but their energy capacity is nothing, or as a way to progress Bishop trading tier to Tier II - though in this case it is better to do that with candles, at least they can be used in Church to boost {{Church Rating}}. However, since cookies can be sold back, an arbitrarily large amount of progress can be generated in one day.
